items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: And this went up there, Willie Parker, and we played, and me, Willie Parker.

ctx.x: If you have a minute yet, could you tell a little bit about when you joined the Eureka Band? Was that the first brass band you played, or any other band?

No, I worked with Willie Parker way back in the present time. Oh, well before I went, no, oh man, way before World War II. El Nero Club, we got $10 in, we spent $10. Incredible, that. The count of a day, now they paid $35 and $40. And this went up there, Willie Parker, and we played, and me, Willie Parker. Howard was with us, and this mix of bands. Willie Manhattan was, the thing was, you know, slow then. I mean, I believe Larry was with us too, and he had got with the Eureka Band too, but he quit the Eureka…
When did you join the Eureka?
